headline: Proposals on snow and ice removal fines, condominium conversions, and an artificial intelligence ordinance.
summary: The agenda also includes a plan to repeal the medical panel for firefighters and police officers. It also lists a new section setting the time and place of regular City Council meetings.
items: Update fines for snow and ice removal violations (Section 1-11(b))
Repeal medical panel for firefighters and police officers (Section 5-45)
Set time and place of regular City Council meetings
